en: Black‑and‑white view down a cobblestone street lined with modest two‑storey houses with steep tiled roofs, leading toward a large brick Gothic church with a stepped gable façade topped by a cross. Shop signs hang from the right‑hand buildings, including one reading "Max Muschik" over a storefront and another on a projecting signboard. A few blurred pedestrians stand or walk along the quiet street. The image has the framing and composition typical of an early 20th‑century picture postcard.
